data.name: Guía TEXTUM
data.description: Bilingual academic-mentoring assistant (Spanish/English) that orients researchers on thesis structure, editorial norms, publication readiness and defence preparation, and recommends the TEXTUM program that fits their situation. It does not write theses, articles or assignments.
data.authentication: none (Cloudflare Turnstile bot check and per-IP rate limits apply)
data.rateLimit: 12 messages per IP per 10 minutes, 4 lead submissions per IP per 10 minutes, 15 messages per session per day
limits: No ghostwriting, no fabricated results, no plagiarism concealment, no authorship impersonation

entries.description: Public conversational agent that diagnoses an academic project (TFG, TFM, doctoral thesis, journal article, defence) and points to the appropriate TEXTUM mentoring program, with prices and integrity boundaries stated explicitly.
representativeQueries: necesito ayuda para estructurar el marco metodológico de mi tesis doctoral
cómo adapto mi artículo a las normas de una revista indexada en Scopus
qué servicio de mentoría encaja con un TFM bloqueado y con plazo ajustado
how do I prepare for my doctoral defence committee and the questions they will ask

entries.description: Machine-readable description of TEXTUM: services, reference prices, methodology TEXTUM FLUX, editorial standards (APA 7, Vancouver, IEEE), academic-integrity policy and frequently asked questions, written as Markdown for language models.
representativeQueries: cuánto cuesta una mentoría para publicar un artículo científico
en qué consiste la metodología TEXTUM FLUX
qué normas de citación trabaja TEXTUM y cuál es su política de integridad académica
what does TEXTUM include in its pre-peer-review program
